watch.name: canary
watch.nl_query: Tell me the moment an email containing OMNESIS-PING-7391 arrives.

nodes.comment: A token that exists nowhere in any corpus, so this watch is perfectly silent until the operator sends it to themselves — which makes it a deterministic stimulus with no false-positive risk. The lexical arm is what makes that possible: an embedding cannot retrieve a rare token, and a filter alone cannot look inside the message. Note the arm reads the TITLE, because a journal event carries no body — the token has to be in the subject line. The proposition says 'title' rather than 'subject' for the same reason: the evidence a judge is handed has a `title` field and no `subject` one, and a model asked to confirm something about a field it cannot see will decline for want of it.

judge.proposition: The title of this document contains the exact text OMNESIS-PING-7391
